primitives.name: Expected Points Added per Dropback
primitives.verbatim_quote: The sample - **2025 full regular season = the base.** 46,452 regular-season plays → **29,239 plays after filters** (17 games per team; 285 games in the file including postseason, which we exclude).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EP_added': 'Expected Points Added (dimensionless)', 'plays_after_filters': 'Number of plays after filtering (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Multinomial logistic regression model for Expected Points, NFLverse-provided EPA values, no re-estimation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regular season baseline; postseason excluded; 17-game schedule per team.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's core efficiency metrics via linear aggregation of play-level EPA.
layer2.telemetry: Average points per dropback, split by offensive and defensive EPA.

primitives.name: Interception-Worthy Throw Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **FTN charting subset** — a human-charted overlay published through nflverse, used here for exactly one column: `is_interception_worthy` (whether a throw was charted as turnover-worthy, 2025 only).
primitives.assumptions: Human-charted binary classification; FTN charting subset provides ground truth.
primitives.breakdown_regime: 2025 season only; small sample due to reliance on human annotations.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSE for situational reasoning about throw difficulty and interception risk.
layer2.telemetry: Count of interception-worthy throws per team/season.

primitives.name: Drive-Level Turnover Impact
primitives.verbatim_quote: The sample - **2025 full regular season = the base.** 46,452 regular-season plays → **29,239 plays after filters** (17 games per team; 285 games in the file including postseason, which we exclude).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'DriveCount': 'Total drives (dimensionless)', 'TurnoverCount': 'Total turnovers (dimensionless)', 'TurnoverType': 'Type of turnover (e.g., INT, fumble) (categorical)'}
primitives.assumptions: Drive-level analysis treats all drives equally regardless of length or context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unfiltered drive data includes garbage-time and punt situations.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's drive-based efficiency metrics, accounting for turnover impact.
layer2.telemetry: Average points lost per turnover drive.

primitives.name: Luck Adjustment Turnover Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is the entire foundation of every team rating and player projection we publish.
primitives.latex: LuckMeter = Actual - Expected = (ActualINTs - LeagueAvgINTRate \times Dropbacks) + (ActualFumblesLost - LeagueAvgFLRate \times Plays)$
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'ActualINTs': 'Actual interceptions (dimensionless)', 'LeagueAvgINTRate': 'League-average INT rate per dropback (dimensionless)', 'Dropbacks': 'Total dropbacks (dimensionless)', 'ActualFumblesLost': 'Actual fumbles lost (dimensionless)', 'LeagueAvgFLRate': 'League-average fumble-lost rate per play (dimensionless)', 'Plays': 'Total plays (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: League-average baselines derived from 2025 data; assumes randomness in turnover occurrence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Long-term turnover probabilities; variance due to skill vs. luck.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's luck-adjustment framework using league averages as counterfactuals.
layer2.telemetry: Difference between actual and expected turnovers per team.

reasoning_traces.think:
These primitives form a coherent stack for NFL analytics. They bridge from play-level Expected Points Added (EPA) to drive-level turnover impacts, incorporating both statistical models and human-charted judgments. The key challenge is separating signal from noise: distinguishing sustainable skill from random luck in turnover generation. This requires careful filtering of the raw data to remove noise from garbage-time plays and post-season anomalies. The primitives also enable cross-layer mapping: the drive-level metrics feed into GSI's overall team ratings, while the interception-worthy metric informs GSE's situational reasoning about throw difficulty.
